title: Surface 49Ti nuclear-qudit control windows: analysis and reproducibility data
description: Version 2.0.0 reproducibility release for a spectroscopy-to-control study of the atomically addressable 49Ti I=7/2 nuclear-spin platform on MgO/Ag(100). It includes the validated low-field 16-level robustness calculation, dense dual-manifold control sweeps, one-at-a-time sensitivity decomposition, field-quadrupole design outputs, source scripts and publication figures.
